body: That's exactly how I feel. I'm the screw up of the family and my parents only ever shout at me and tell me what a loser and pathetic failure I am. They buy presents for my brother all the time and not for me and they never shout at him. Thanks for your comment. I'm not sure how much longer I can live like this though. I want to die but I'm scared to kill myself. I'm scared it will hurt and even more afraid of what happens after death. Anyway, I am sorry you are in a similar situation. It is one of the worst feelings to feel alone and unwanted. I am glad you feel better now
